pipeline.title: UDDI (cdc.darknetian.com)
pipeline.description: Normalize UDDI CEF events into the same dns_* / rcode / qname / qtype / dns_is_* shape the NIOS pipelines emit, then trim the CEF cruft fields that nothing queries so the index doesn't blow past OpenSearch's 1000-field cap on rotation.

rules.title: uddi_normalize_dns_fields
rules.description: UDDI CEF → normalized DNS fields. The Graylog CEF input plugin already parses the Infoblox CEF key=value pairs into top-level GELF fields (InfobloxDNSRCode, destinationDnsDomain, InfobloxDNSQType, deviceAddress, etc.). This rule just aliases them to the dashboard's expected field names and computes the dns_is_* booleans, matching the shape the NIOS pipelines produce.

rules.title: uddi_trim_unused_fields
rules.description: Drop CEF cruft that no dashboard widget queries. UDDI events arrive with 50+ fields (CEF spec is wide); cumulative cardinality across multiple event types eats the index's 1000-field cap inside ~1 rotation. Keep allowlist: event_class_id, client_*, qname/qtype/qclass/rcode, dns_event_type, dns_is_*, sender_*, source, severity, level, message, name, gl2_*, streams, timestamp, plus the raw InfobloxDNSRCode/QType the normalize rule reads. Runs after stage 0 so we don't drop destinationDnsDomain before it's aliased to qname.
